suites.description: One correctness-gated public workflow for every PipelineOp variant.
Existing public multi-operation workflows measured as benchmark-only execution inputs.
Benchmark-only public terminal reads over a lazy native pipeline, including banded getdata without RGBA widening.
Large-window byte and float rank-filter pipelines used to measure the optimized neighborhood paths.
Material-sized public byte and I-mode 3x3 and 5x5 convolution pipelines used to measure specialized row execution.
Non-square 32x24 variants for ordinary byte-image operations.
Four additional public size variants for selected geometry, neighborhood, point, multi-image, and enhancement operations.
Benchmark-only public invert, solarize, posterize, and point chains across L, LA, RGB, and RGBA layouts.
Material-sized public LA and RGBA alpha-composite workflows used to measure native SIMD alpha arithmetic.
Explicit-size public invert→mirror workloads used to measure the SIMD crossover instead of assuming one.
Material-sized public byte-wise ImageChops workloads used to measure exact native SIMD lanes.
Explicit-size public ImageChops.constant workloads used to measure the direct native L-result path.
Public multiply→screen chains across L, LA, RGB, and RGBA layouts used to measure secondary-image reuse and row-parallel fused execution.
Public multiply→screen chains whose secondary images have equal pixels but distinct source identities; these verify the fusion guard does not alias by value.
Explicit-size public L point/LUT compositions used to measure arbitrary nibble-table lookup on SIMD.
Explicit-size public RGB point/LUT compositions used to measure per-band SIMD lookup.
Material-sized LA and RGBA resize workflows for fused alpha resampling.
Public F-mode and I-mode resize workflows used to measure typed native row execution.
Repeated public RGB and F-mode resize workflows with identical coefficient geometry.
Material-sized transpose, crop, reduce, and rotate workflows for geometry kernels.
Native-layout Crop and CropBorder workflows used to measure copy-only backend routing across L/LA/RGB/RGBA.
Material-sized Gaussian and box blur workflows used to measure the rolling vertical path across RGB and RGBA.
A 260-operation public multiply/screen chain that crosses the GPU submission chunk boundary.
Benchmark-only valid color-mode conversion, quantization, palette, and band-extraction workflows.
Non-uniform public gradient inputs for median-cut quantization performance.
Repeated public mode and size observations over lazy invert chains.
Public lazy invert chains at 1, 8, 64, 1,024, and 10,000 operations for append and flatten measurements.
Representative warm 1024x1024 RGB two-operation pipelines.
Cold-process and already-resident terminal observations for the four representative public pipelines.
